implementation_note: Second implementation slice of the milestone-integrated SDK plan; delivered inside the existing document owner, not as a separate SDK phase.
app_features: om9-app --no-default-features (standalone Controller/document/scene/archive; no OCCT adapter, no FreeCAD/Rhino host)
asserted_semantics: query_objects is ordered by object ID, includes the command's staged additions and attribute edits, supports layer, exact geometry kind, case-sensitive label substring, only_selected and include_hidden filters, and returns total plus page.
A page limit of zero selects the host default 256; a limit above 1024 is a budget refusal, never a silent truncation.

object_attributes reports stored and effective flags after the layer chain plus generation, geometry_revision and attributes_revision; a staged edit is visible to later reads in the same command with the revision the commit will publish.
set_object_attributes supports #rrggbb/#rrggbbaa or an empty colour, visible, hidden, selectable and locked; the object's layer must be editable while object-level lock/hidden stay editable.
rename_object applies the document label grammar and becomes a Mutation::Label.
One command may stage only one of placement, attributes or rename per object; a second kind is refused with the conflict code before commit.
A layer created by the same command cannot receive newly added objects (transaction insert admission validates the captured world); that flow needs two commands.

Geometry editing remains read-only in the SDK; only attributes and labels are written.
